title: Posts
description: Compose, schedule and track posts across your clients’ accounts.

empty.title: No posts yet
empty.description: Create a post for one of your clients and publish it now or schedule it.

deleteWarning: This only removes it here. Anything already published stays on the platform.

issues.FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED: This account can’t publish this format
issues.MIXED_MEDIA: A video has to be the only file
issues.IMAGE_REQUIRED: A single video goes out as a Reel — pick Reel
issues.ASPECT_RATIO: File proportions don’t fit this format

composer.caption: Caption

composer.noAccounts: This client has no connected accounts yet.

tiktok.brandedPrivateNote: A paid partnership can’t be private on TikTok. Pick another visibility.

youtube.heading: YouTube
youtube.title: Video title

youtube.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter or comma

youtube.thumbnailInvalid: Pick a JPEG or PNG image of up to 2 MB.

actions.publishNowConfirm: Publish to the selected accounts now?

composer.fromTask: This post will be linked to the task you started from.

postingSlots.title: Posting times
postingSlots.description: "Add to queue" schedules posts at the next free time below. Times are in the client's time zone:

import.title: Import posts from CSV
import.done: {count, plural, one {# post scheduled.} other {# posts scheduled.}}
import.description: One post per row: date and time in the client's time zone, accounts (platform names like facebook, account names, separated by ;), and optionally format, caption, first_comment, media (file names from the media library, separated by ;) and title (YouTube). Every row is checked before anything is created.
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.

errors.MEDIA_NOT_FOUND: File not in the media library

toolbar.pickClientForSlots: Filter by a client to set its posting times
